name: Examination
definition: 由医疗机构针对特定就诊者的一次就诊过程所记录的、包含多项实验室检测项目结果与临床诊断信息的医学信息记录。 Counterexample: 与 Laboratory 的辨析：Laboratory 记录的是生化与血液学等常规检验项目的数值结果，Examination 记录的是抗磷脂抗体、ANA、狼疮抗凝物等免疫与凝血专项检查结果及诊断结论，二者是不同检验类别的信息记录。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table Examination; provenance: direct source Examination

name: Laboratory
definition: 由医疗机构针对特定就诊者的一次就诊过程所记录的、包含生化、血液学与凝血等常规检验项目数值结果的医学信息记录。 Counterexample: 与 Examination 的辨析：Examination 记录免疫与凝血专项检查及诊断结论，Laboratory 记录常规生化与血液学检验数值，二者是不同检验类别的信息记录。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table Laboratory; provenance: direct source Laboratory

name: Patient
definition: 在医疗机构接受诊断、治疗或医学检查服务的自然人。 Counterexample: 与 Examination、Laboratory 的辨析：患者是接受医疗服务的自然人，而 Examination 与 Laboratory 是该自然人在就诊过程中产生的检查与检验信息记录，前者是服务对象，后者是服务产物。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table Patient; provenance: direct source Patient

name: Albumin
definition: Blood albumin concentration measured in laboratory tests.

name: PlateletCount
definition: Platelet count measured in laboratory tests.

name: GPT
definition: Alanine aminotransferase enzyme level measured in laboratory tests.

name: Glucose
definition: Blood glucose concentration measured in laboratory tests.

name: TotalCholesterol
definition: Total cholesterol concentration measured in laboratory tests.

name: IgM
definition: Immunoglobulin M level measured in laboratory tests.

name: CreatinePhosphokinase
definition: Creatine phosphokinase enzyme level measured in laboratory tests.

name: CReactiveProtein
definition: C-reactive protein level measured in laboratory tests.

name: Creatinine
definition: Serum creatinine concentration measured in laboratory tests.

name: UreaNitrogen
definition: Urea nitrogen concentration measured in laboratory tests.

name: IgG
definition: Immunoglobulin G level measured in laboratory tests.

name: AntiCardiolipinIgM
definition: Anti-cardiolipin antibody IgM level measured in examination.

name: CoagulationPositive
definition: Presence of any positive coagulation test result (KCT, RVVT, or LAC).
scope: Examination where KCT = '+' OR RVVT = '+' OR LAC = '+'
aliases: positive measure of degree of coagulation

name: RVVT
definition: Russell viper venom time test result.

name: Thrombosis
definition: Thrombosis grade or level recorded in examination.

name: ANAPattern
definition: Antinuclear antibody pattern observed in examination.

name: Symptoms
definition: Clinical symptoms recorded for the patient.

name: Diagnosis
definition: Diagnosis assigned to the patient.

name: Sex
definition: Patient biological sex.

name: Age
definition: Patient age computed from birthday.

name: Admission
definition: Whether patient is admitted (in-patient) or not (outpatient).

name: Description
definition: Free-text description field for patient.

name: AntiCentromere
definition: Anti-centromere antibody test result.

name: AntiSSB
definition: Anti-SSB antibody test result.

name: AntiScl70
definition: Anti-scl-70 antibody test result.

name: AverageAlbumin
definition: Average albumin level across selected patients. Formula: AVG(Albumin). Inputs: Albumin = Laboratory.ALB

name: AverageAge
definition: Average age of selected patients. Formula: AVG(Age). Inputs: Age = Patient.Birthday

name: AbnormalIgM
definition: IgM level outside normal range. Formula: IgM <= 40 OR IgM >= 400. Inputs: IgM = Laboratory.IGM

name: AbnormalCreatinine
definition: Creatinine level above normal threshold. Formula: Creatinine >= 1.5. Inputs: Creatinine = Laboratory.CRE

name: AbnormalGlucose
definition: Glucose level outside normal range. Formula: Glucose >= 180. Inputs: Glucose = Laboratory.GLU
aliases: blood glucose not within normal range

name: AbnormalCholesterol
definition: Total cholesterol above normal threshold. Formula: TotalCholesterol >= 250. Inputs: TotalCholesterol = Laboratory.T-CHO

name: AbnormalCPK
definition: Creatine phosphokinase above normal threshold. Formula: CreatinePhosphokinase >= 250. Inputs: CreatinePhosphokinase = Laboratory.CPK

name: AbnormalGPT
definition: GPT level above normal threshold. Formula: GPT >= 60. Inputs: GPT = Laboratory.GPT

name: NormalIgG
definition: IgG level within normal range. Formula: IgG > 900 AND IgG < 2000. Inputs: IgG = Laboratory.IGG

name: NormalCPK
definition: Creatine phosphokinase within normal range. Formula: CreatinePhosphokinase < 250. Inputs: CreatinePhosphokinase = Laboratory.CPK

name: NormalAntiCentromere
definition: Anti-centromere antibody within normal range. Formula: AntiCentromere IN ('-', '+-'). Inputs: AntiCentromere = Laboratory.CENTROMEA

name: NormalAntiSSB
definition: Anti-SSB antibody within normal range. Formula: AntiSSB IN ('-', '+-'). Inputs: AntiSSB = Laboratory.SSB

name: NormalAntiScl70
definition: Anti-scl-70 antibody within normal range. Formula: AntiScl70 IN ('negative', '0'). Inputs: AntiScl70 = Laboratory.SC170

name: PositiveCoagulationRate
definition: Proportion of patients with positive coagulation test. Formula: COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id WHERE CoagulationPositive) / COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id). Inputs: CoagulationPositive = Examination.KCT WHERE KCT = '+' OR RVVT = '+' OR LAC = '+'
aliases: positive measure of degree of coagulation

name: InpatientOutpatientDeviation
definition: Percentage difference between male in-patients and male outpatients. Formula: (COUNT(male in-patients) - COUNT(male outpatients)) / COUNT(male in-patients) * 100. Inputs: Admission = Patient.Admission; Sex = Patient.SEX

name: Diagnosis
definition: Patient diagnosis codes used to classify disease.

name: AdmissionStatus
definition: Whether patient is admitted or outpatient.

name: Sex
definition: Patient sex codes.

name: ThrombosisGrade
definition: Thrombosis severity grade codes.

name: CoagulationTest
definition: Coagulation test result codes.

name: AntiScl70Result
definition: Anti-scl-70 antibody result codes.
